profile: Abeona Therapeutics is a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company developing treatments for rare and serious diseases. Its FDA-approved ZEVASKYN is an autologous gene-modified cell therapy for wounds in patients with recessive dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa. Its development portfolio includes ABO-701, an engineered T-cell therapy for solid tumors, and ABO-801, a Phase 3-ready oral fluticasone candidate acquired in November 2026 for eosinophilic esophagitis.
